name: Clerk
purpose: User identity: sign-up, sign-in, sessions, and organizations for every client build.

tasks.title: Create separate Development and Production instances
steps: Create one Clerk application per client build
Keep dev and prod instances separate; never point prod at dev keys
Set the production domain and verify its DNS records in Cloudflare (NN-CLOUDFLARE)
tasks.doneWhen: Prod instance is live on the client domain with verified DNS.

tasks.title: Store keys as environment secrets
steps: Add the env vars listed above to the host and to GitHub Actions secrets
Only NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY may ship to the browser
Confirm no key is committed (GitHub secret scanning on, NN-GITHUB-03)
tasks.doneWhen: App boots with keys from the environment only; repo scan is clean.

tasks.title: Protect routes with middleware
steps: Add clerkMiddleware() and mark public routes explicitly; everything else requires a session
Protect API routes server-side, not only in the UI
tasks.doneWhen: Signed-out requests to a protected page or API route are rejected.

tasks.title: Sync users to Supabase via webhook
steps: Verify every webhook signature with CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET
Use the Clerk user ID as the owner key in Supabase RLS policies (NN-SUPABASE-03)
tasks.doneWhen: Creating and deleting a test user is reflected in Supabase.

tasks.title: Run auth end-to-end tests
steps: Playwright covers sign-up, sign-in, sign-out, and a protected-route redirect (NN-PLAYWRIGHT-03)
Use Clerk testing tokens; never real accounts
tasks.doneWhen: Auth suite passes in CI on the release commit.

tasks.title: Quarterly key rotation and access review
steps: Rotate CLERK_SECRET_KEY and the webhook secret
Review dashboard members and remove anyone no longer on the project
tasks.doneWhen: Rotation date logged; member list matches the current team.
